articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) ("Mawson" or "the Company"), a publicly-traded technology company focused on digital infrastructure platforms for artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), and digital assets, announced today that it will participate in Metro Connect USA 2025, taking place on February 24-26, 2025 in Fort Lauderdale.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Announces Participation in Metro Connect USA 2025
